# A regional network for shared challenges

Infectious diseases cross borders. The expertise needed to understand and
respond to them must cross borders too.

MIDSEA brings together people from across Southeast Asia to learn from one another, develop locally relevant approaches, and apply infectious disease modelling to the public health priorities of our region.
:::
